title: Conditional cylinder error criterion for existence and uniqueness of a real limit
purpose: Record Lean-checked analytic bridges: a pairwise absolute error bound tending to zero makes one already-defined cylinder-observable sequence Cauchy and convergent in R, and positivity, normalization, or a zero stationarity identity pass to an already-proved limit. This support packet does not define a PAH sector law or a full-Q Gibbs state.

lean.scope: A sequence of real values with a pairwise absolute-error bound b(n) for n <= m and b tending to zero; conditional inheritance of positivity, unit normalization, or zero stationarity; no PAH instantiation.

assumptions: s is a real-valued sequence representing one already-defined cylinder observable along the fixed ordered limit.
b is a real-valued error sequence with |s(n)-s(m)| <= b(n) whenever n <= m.
b tends to zero along the declared ordered limit.
For an inherited property, every finite term is nonnegative, identically one, or identically zero as specified by the corresponding theorem.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The sequence s is Cauchy and therefore has a unique real limit; if a limit is already known, finite-term positivity, unit normalization, and zero stationarity pass to it.
not_supplied: No definition of mu_(n,R), omega, or a common cylinder probability space.
No PAH-specific Cauchy estimate, topology, projective consistency or R-488 bound.
No stationarity passage or boundary-defect estimate.

non_claims: This theorem does not instantiate a PAH full-Q sector law, mu_(n,R) or omega.

It does not prove a PAH-specific error bound, projective consistency, positivity/normalization of a constructed Gibbs mixture, R-488 nonzero, infinite-volume dynamics or stationarity passage from PAH data.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
